title: Mobile, the 'Pensacola Jazz' name, nearby towns and radio broadcasts
summary: The band is unnamed until a big night at Brooklyn Park in Mobile wins them the name Pensacola Jazz; they play Alabama and Florida towns, the radio station and a hotel.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: well look so we didn't have no particular name when we got to Mobile and we played at this park I know this is another big ballparking mobile called the Brooklyn Park and after we played that the first time the people had heard about us and we had played this number Christine we had that down good we had the bugle car rags down good we had Bucket get a hole in it the old New Orleans stump good rhythm bounce good tempos you know and we'd advertise just like we do here we'd advertise before the dance and they had bands used to come over there like Sam Morgan and Punch used to come over there at that time the band used to bring leave New Orleans and go to those places like that you see and we used to buck there like we did here well this particular night the people took a liking to our group and we had the biggest crowd that they ever had at that particular part and they started calling us the Pensacola Jazz that's how they got that name Pensacola Jazz well then we'd go places like Montgomery and we played another place like Bruton and Flemington I believe Alabama that's all on the outskirts of Pensacola yeah I know those two yeah and then Scambia County yeah Scambia County yeah Pollard
huh Pollard Alabama ever been there?

maybe we did pass through there that's neat well anyhow I tell you the band that band had a real good beat to it I mean the white people like it the colored people like it and then around Pensacola we played there was a station there one radio station there they used to let us broadcast and we got a lot of calls and letters from that and there was a place there the Pallet Fox Hotel we played there a couple of times of course we were still working for this Sam place here with this colored doctor but that was only like I said it would be on a Monday or Wednesday or Friday and a Saturday see we had those Sundays and Wednesdays to play those other dances
